newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-CD Radio as speculative buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CD Radio as speculative buy.

text.p: -- Unterberg Harris said analyst Robert Kaimowitz initiated coverage of CD Radio Inc as a speculative buy.
-- estimated the company would lose $0.70 per share this year, and $0.72 in 1998 and continue to lose money at least through the year 2001.
-- said there were "significant" risks associated with the company, including an unproven market for the product, satellite launch failure, technical hurdles and substantial financial requirements.

-- company is a pioneer in the business of satellite digital audio radio service, or broadcasting radio programs from a satellite directly to a car. The company plans to offer 30 channels of commercial free, CD quality, music programming and 20 channels of all-news, all-sports and all-talk within three years. It would be offered on a subscription basis.
-- set year-end 1997 price target of $20-$24. Shares rose 1-3/8 to 13-1/4.
